title: Trial of Stoning
summary: Protect the accused from their avengers through four waves and defeat Yurae Zhaleem.
overview: Protect the accused from their avengers through four waves and defeat Yurae Zhaleem.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Four enemies arrive per wave on a ninety-second schedule. Avengers threaten the accused while enemies remain alive.
Clear the active wave quickly to remove the avengers and stop their pressure on the prisoners.
The sixteenth required wave kill summons Yurae Zhaleem. Establish the boss tank while protecting the survivors.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
